meta.title: Compatibility check
meta.description: Runs the plugin compatibility pre-check against the newest release and reports whether the plugins you have installed will survive the update.

panel.idle: Not run yet in this session
panel.warn: WARN — update possible, but check the report
panel.unknown: UNKNOWN — the check did not finish
panel.offline: Registry unreachable — enter the target version instead
panel.blockHint: Do not update yet. Deal with these plugins first; nothing is disabled or changed automatically.
